description: A map of sets converts to a map of lists when one set holds an unknown element
notes: The input needs a map of sets of lists whose innermost element type is the dynamic pseudo-type (m), which the spec has no value for: the dynamic pseudo-type is a placeholder for a type that isn't known yet, so no value should have it as a collection's element type. Apart from that, the spec gives the same result. The test only checks that the conversion succeeds, through the converted map's keys: hashicorp/hcl gives the result the element type list(list(dynamic)) instead of list(list(number)), because go-cty converts a set of unknown length to an unknown list of the set's own element type, list(list(dynamic)) (conversionCollectionToList in cty/convert/conversion_collection.go), and conversionCollectionToMap then unifies the map's converted elements with safe conversions only (conversionUnifyCollectionElements), under which number and the dynamic pseudo-type unify to the dynamic pseudo-type.
